metadata.name: GTA 6 vehicles: models, classes, in-game stats and how to get them
metadata.methodology: Cada dato conserva sus IDs de fuente. Un nombre se considera corroborado solo con dos grupos editoriales post-lanzamiento independientes y sin derivación. Las estadísticas WAiNK son valores del panel del juego de 0 a 10, no velocidades físicas. Se excluyeron comparaciones con vehículos reales y afirmaciones anteriores al lanzamiento.
metadata.limitations: El conjunto abierto contiene 90 registros, no los 277 modelos base completos. Los recuentos por clase son de un censo comunitario, no de una declaración de Rockstar. Muchos datos dependen de una sola guía.

mechanics.fact: Pointing the WAiNK phone app at a vehicle logs the model in the Progress Database and shows its security type, sale value and registration fee.
The vehicle part of 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned; Standout variants do not count, boats and aircraft do.
During Chapter 1 Jason can only keep his own '70 Vapid Ganado as a personal car.
After the Chapter 2 mission Moses in Port Gellhorn, a stolen car with no tracker can be registered as a personal vehicle for a fee through the Scooter Bros service.
Locked older cars are opened with the Slim Jim, a timed-input tool received in the Moses mission.
A car with a standard tracker alerts police when taken; from Chapter 3 such cars can be sold or registered at a Pay 'n' Spray.
Keyless high-end cars need the Key Cloner (from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs); an advanced tracker forces you to keep above a set speed until the drop-off.
Moses in Port Gellhorn pays for untracked stolen cars (roughly $1,000 and up per PowerPyx) and offers 7 specific drop-off jobs; finishing all 7 earns his Emperor Sultan.

Randy at Leonida Auto World in west Vice City pays the most, for a wish list of high-end cars; sources disagree on its length (16 named by PowerPyx's trophy guide and by nettoge, 18 per PowerPyx's money guide, 22 per Push Square's unfinished page); listed cars can also be taken off the street.
Reported Pay 'n' Spray payouts for standard-tracker cars differ inside PowerPyx itself: about $2,500+ (100% guide) vs about $4,000+ (money guide); Randy pays about $30,000-35,000+ for sports cars.
Completion tracking includes a $200,000 total for vehicles fenced.
There are 12 garages; 8 are purchasable, from $4,000 (Mitchell Auto Center) to $40,000 (Atlantic Court), $160,000 in total, opening after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver.
Personal vehicle capacity is reported differently: nettoge says 4 slots at first and more than 12 with garages; PowerPyx says 1 garage slot at first and 18 at most.
The Scooter Bros app delivers registered vehicles; nettoge reports a $12,500 premium tier with 3 free deliveries a day and free impound recovery.
Every vehicle uses fuel, refilled at 57 gas stations.
19 Pay 'n' Spray shops repair and repaint vehicles.
14 mod shops each serve a vehicle type (for example Euroform Automotive for luxury and supercars, Capri Classic for muscle, Wasteland Off-Road for trucks); 2 of them are Ultimate Edition only.
The in-game vehicle panel shows Speed, Acceleration, Handling (asphalt), Handling (off-road) and Durability on a 0-10 scale, plus asphalt and off-road ratings.
21 spawn-vehicle cheats exist; each is unlocked by a challenge and usable only after finishing the story.
Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County holds the tank, the P-996 Lazer and other military vehicles; entering brings a wanted level.
GTA+ members get a Crosstown garage for selling stolen cars and higher sale prices, per nettoge.

items.name: Interstate Ambulance

how.text: Spawn cheat, usable after the story ends; unlock condition: discover the Interstate Ambulance in the Progress menu.

items.notes: nettoge lists the ambulance as 'Declasse Ambulance' (emergency vehicle, in-game speed 3.0, fastest service vehicle); four English guides give the cheat name 'Interstate Ambulance'. Unclear whether these are two models or a make mix-up, so the 3.0 value is kept as a claim only.

how.text: On Randy's Wish List: steal one and deliver it to Randy at Leonida Auto World in west Vice City for a payout. Also a spawn cheat (unlock: complete all combat challenges).

locations: Outside Sweetbay Inn, East Buckley Dr, Capri (seen around 3 AM)

items.name: '70 Vapid Ganado

how.text: Jason's starting personal car and the only one available in Chapter 1; it is later replaced and its mods are not kept. Ultimate Edition adds a Retro livery/build for it in Chapter 1.

items.notes: Game8 lists it as "Jason's '70 Ganado" under Muscle Cars. nettoge shows two Speed readings: 4.7 in the table and 4.9/5.5 (speed/acceleration) on the in-game panel write-up; ratings 330 asphalt / 458 off-road (342/469 with the Retro build).
